// Native lock-screen call UI. Never renders the couple's private chat while locked.
// Generated by scripts/configure-native.mjs; modify this repository template.
package __PACKAGE__;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.WindowManager;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.TextView;
import java.util.UUID;

public final class NativeIncomingCallActivity extends Activity {
    private String callId;
    private static GradientDrawable rounded(int color,int radius){
        GradientDrawable background=new GradientDrawable();
        background.setColor(color);
        background.setCornerRadius(radius);
        return background;
    }
    private TextView title(String text,int size,int color){
        TextView view=new TextView(this);
        view.setText(text);view.setTextColor(color);
        view.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);view.setTextSize(size);
        view.setTypeface(Typeface.DEFAULT,Typeface.BOLD);
        return view;
    }
    private Button actionButton(String text,int backgroundColor){
        Button button=new Button(this);
        button.setText(text);button.setTextSize(17);button.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        button.setAllCaps(false);button.setBackground(rounded(backgroundColor,42));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams params=new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,66,1);
        params.setMargins(6,0,6,0);
        button.setLayoutParams(params);
        return button;
    }
    @Override public void onCreate(Bundle state){
        super.onCreate(state);
        final Intent received=getIntent();
        callId=received==null?null:received.getStringExtra("callId");
        long expires=received==null?0:received.getLongExtra("expiresAt",0L);
        if(callId==null||!callId.matches("(?i)[0-9a-f-]{36}")||
           expires<=System.currentTimeMillis()){
            finish();return;
        }
        if(Build.VERSION.SDK_INT>=Build.VERSION_CODES.O_MR1){
            setShowWhenLocked(true);
            setTurnScreenOn(true);
        }else{
            getWindow().addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SHOW_WHEN_LOCKED|
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_TURN_SCREEN_ON);
        }
        getWindow().addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON);
        getWindow().setStatusBarColor(Color.rgb(18,16,37));
        getWindow().setNavigationBarColor(Color.rgb(18,16,37));
        LinearLayout screen=new LinearLayout(this);
        screen.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        screen.setPadding(28,40,28,32);
        screen.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL);
        screen.setBackground(new GradientDrawable(
            GradientDrawable.Orientation.TL_BR,
            new int[]{Color.rgb(64,43,81),Color.rgb(21,25,50),Color.rgb(14,17,34)}));
        String mode=received.getStringExtra("mode");
        String caller=received.getStringExtra("callerName");
        if(caller==null||caller.isEmpty())caller="Ton partenaire";
        caller=caller.replaceAll("[\\r\\n\\t<>]","").trim();
        if(caller.length()>60)caller=caller.substring(0,60);
        TextView heading=title("LOVE RADAR  ♥",18,Color.rgb(255,181,216));
        screen.addView(heading,new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1,52));
        View empty=new View(this);
        screen.addView(empty,new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(1,0,1));
        TextView avatar=title("♡",92,Color.WHITE);
        screen.addView(avatar,new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1,128));
        TextView name=title(caller,32,Color.WHITE);
        screen.addView(name,new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1,80));
        TextView detail=title("Appel "+("video".equals(mode)?"vidéo":"vocal")+" entrant…",16,Color.rgb(219,207,225));
        screen.addView(detail,new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1,45));
        View gap=new View(this);
        screen.addView(gap,new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(1,0,1));
        LinearLayout buttons=new LinearLayout(this);
        buttons.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        buttons.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        Button decline=actionButton("Refuser",Color.rgb(214,38,80));
        Button answer=actionButton("Décrocher",Color.rgb(22,170,108));
        buttons.addView(decline);buttons.addView(answer);
        screen.addView(buttons,new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1,78));
        TextView hint=title("L'application s'ouvrira pour connecter le micro et la caméra.",12,Color.rgb(185,170,197));
        hint.setTypeface(Typeface.DEFAULT);
        screen.addView(hint,new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1,72));
        setContentView(screen);
        decline.setOnClickListener(view->continueCall("end"));
        answer.setOnClickListener(view->continueCall("answer"));
    }
    private void continueCall(String action){
        if(callId==null)return;
        // The session bearer token stays in the authenticated JavaScript process.
        // The native screen cannot access chat data or silently activate mic/camera.
        NativeVoipPlugin.recordAction(this,action,callId);
        NotificationManager manager=(NotificationManager)getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
        if(manager!=null)manager.cancel(NativeVoipMessageService.INCOMING_NOTIFICATION_ID);
        Intent open=new Intent(this,MainActivity.class);
        open.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP|Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP);
        open.putExtra("lrNativeCallAction",action);
        open.putExtra("lrNativeCallId",callId);
        startActivity(open);
        finish();
    }
}
